name: Core Output Verification Pack
outcome: Indexes the five independent core-output recompute chains — interest accrual (art-661), overdraft/NSF fee application (art-662), APY-earned (art-663), loan-servicing payment-application waterfall (art-664), and GL tie-out (art-665) — as one on-demand pack. Each chain takes a batch, caller-pasted statement export, independently recomputes the figure from those same inputs, and receipts its run per SPEC.md §18; this pack-level manifest is the chain-of-receipts index over those per-chain receipts (one receipt per chain per run), itself a content-digested artifact following the existing OKF bundle pattern used by art-342 — it is not a new envelope type and asserts no execution event of its own. Account/customer identifiers are caller-supplied opaque tokens or hashes; no name, SSN, or address field exists in any chain's input contract, and account scope is reported by count of tokens, never by identity. On-demand mode only: manual trigger, batch caller-pasted input — the pack does nothing until a caller runs it, and this row ships no automation of any kind. CORE-VERIFY-PACK-1 (CORE-VERIFY-BUILD-SPEC.md §8).
